verdict.rationale: Orama supports document insert/update/delete with insert/insertMultiple documented as quick and safe for large volumes, and search operates purely in-memory/in-process so new documents are immediately queryable without a rebuild step, as shown in the runtime probe. However, evidence does not explicitly discuss update/delete APIs, index consistency guarantees, or real-time indexing latency at scale, nor any documentation of incremental reindexing internals for large datasets. missing for 10: explicit docs on update/remove document APIs, evidence on index consistency/latency under concurrent writes, and confirmation of no periodic reindex requirement for Orama Cloud (vs only the JS library).
